AcceptApproveCommand.description_en: If an O&M engineer executes a command configured in a command approval control policy, the administrator receives an approval request for the command in the Bastionhost console. The command can be executed only after the administrator approves it. If the approval is rejected, the command cannot be executed
AcceptApproveCommand.description_zh: 如果运维员执行了配置在命令审批控制策略中的命令，管理员会在堡垒机控制台收到该命令的审批，只有管理员审批允许后该命令才能正常执行，审批拒绝后该命令不可执行

AcceptOperationTicket.description_en: If an administrator enables O&M approval in a control policy, an O&M engineer must submit an O&M request and obtain administrator approval before logging on to an asset
AcceptOperationTicket.description_zh: 如果管理员配置控制策略时开启了运维审批，则运维员登录资产时，需要申请运维且管理员审批通过后才能进行运维

AddDatabasesToGroup.description_en: Adds multiple databases to a specified asset group
AddDatabasesToGroup.description_zh: 批量将数据库实例加入指定资产组

AddHostsToGroup.description_en: Adds multiple hosts to a specified asset group in a batch
AddHostsToGroup.description_zh: 批量将主机加入指定资产组

AddInstanceRdMember.description_en: Adds a Resource Directory (RD) member account to a Bastionhost instance so that you can import and manage the cloud assets of the member account through Bastionhost

AddUsersToGroup.description_en: Adds users to a user group in a batch
AddUsersToGroup.description_zh: 将用户批量添加到用户组

AllowOperationTaskApproval.description_en: Approves an O&M task execution request
AllowOperationTaskApproval.description_zh: 允许运维任务执行申请

AttachDatabaseAccountsToUser.description_en: Authorizes a user to manage databases and database accounts
AttachDatabaseAccountsToUser.description_zh: 为用户授权数据库及数据库账户

AttachDatabaseAccountsToUserGroup.description_en: Grants a user group permissions on databases and database accounts
AttachDatabaseAccountsToUserGroup.description_zh: 为用户组授权数据库及数据库账户

AttachHostAccountsToHostShareKey.description_en: Associates host accounts with a host shared key
AttachHostAccountsToHostShareKey.description_zh: 关联主机账号到主机共享密钥

AttachHostAccountsToUser.description_en: After you add a user to your bastion host, you must authorize the user to manage assets. Only authorized users can log on to the bastion host to perform O\\\\\\&M operations on the assets
AttachHostAccountsToUser.description_zh: 当您新建用户之后，您需要为该用户授权资产。授权后该用户才可以使用堡垒机运维已授权的资产

AttachHostAccountsToUserGroup.description_en: Grants a user group permissions on hosts and host accounts
AttachHostAccountsToUserGroup.description_zh: 为用户组授权主机及主机账户

AttachHostGroupAccountsToUser.description_en: Authorizes a user to manage one or more host groups and host accounts
AttachHostGroupAccountsToUser.description_zh: 为用户授权主机组和主机账号

AttachHostGroupAccountsToUserGroup.description_en: Authorizes a user to manage one or more host groups and host accounts
AttachHostGroupAccountsToUserGroup.description_zh: 为用户组授权主机组和主机账号

AttachProjectsToProjectAuthorization.description_en: Specifies manageable projects in a project authorization. This operation can be called only when the ScopeType parameter returned by the GetProjectAuthorization operation is 2 for the corresponding project authorization
AttachProjectsToProjectAuthorization.description_zh: 在项目授权中指定可管理的项目。仅当通过GetProjectAuthorization接口获取到的对应项目授权中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口

AttachProjectsToReviewRule.description_en: Associates projects with the scope of an audit policy. This operation can be invoked only when the ScopeType parameter returned by the GetReviewRule operation is 2
AttachProjectsToReviewRule.description_zh: 关联审计规则范围项目。仅当通过GetReviewRule接口获取到的对应审计规则中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口

AttachReviewersToReviewRule.description_en: Associates auditors with an audit policy
AttachReviewersToReviewRule.description_zh: 绑定审计员到审计规则

ConfigInstanceSecurityGroups.description_en: Configures the security groups that control inbound and outbound network traffic for a Bastionhost instance
ConfigInstanceSecurityGroups.description_zh: 为指定的堡垒机实例配置安全组

ConfigInstanceWhiteList.description_en: After enabling public network access for a Bastionhost instance, you can add IP addresses to a whitelist to control access
ConfigInstanceWhiteList.description_zh: 堡垒机实例开启公网访问后，可以将指定公网IP地址加入白名单，允许公网流量访问堡垒机实例

CreateDatabase.description_en: Imports database assets into a bastion host. Supported database types include MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL for ApsaraDB RDS instances, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) for PolarDB clusters, and MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle for self-managed databases
CreateDatabase.description_zh: 您可以通过本接口，将MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL类型的RDS和MySQL、PostgreSQL、PostgreSQL（兼容Oracle）的PolarDB以及MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、Oracle类型的自建数据库资产导入至堡垒机

CreateDatabaseAccount.description_en: After a database is created, you can create a database account for it. After the account is created, O&M engineers can use the account to log on to and manage the database
CreateDatabaseAccount.description_zh: 数据库创建成功后，您可以为其新建数据库账户。创建成功后，运维员可以使用该账号登录并运维数据库

CreateExportConfigJob.description_en: Creates a configuration backup export task. Only one configuration backup export task can run at a time for a Bastionhost instance
CreateExportConfigJob.description_zh: 创建配置备份导出任务。一个堡垒机实例只能同时存在一个正在运行的配置备份导出任务

CreateHost.description_en: Creates a host in a Bastionhost instance. Bastionhost supports O&M for hosts from different sources, including Alibaba Cloud ECS instances, on-premises IDC servers, and servers on other clouds. Before you perform O&M on a host through Bastionhost, you must first import the host into Bastionhost. You can call this operation to create a host that you want to manage in Bastionhost
CreateHost.description_zh: 堡垒机支持运维阿里云ECS服务器、线下IDC服务器以及其他云上服务器等不同来源的主机。在通过堡垒机运维主机之前，首先需要在堡垒机中导入主机。您可以参考本接口在堡垒机中创建需要运维的主机

CreateHostAccount.description_en: After you create a host in Bastionhost, you can create a host account for the host to manage the existing account of the host in Bastionhost. After you create a host account, O&M engineers can use the account to log on to the host through Bastionhost for O&M operations
CreateHostAccount.description_zh: 在堡垒机中新建主机后，您可以为其创建相应的主机账户，即将您主机已有的账户托管至堡垒机。创建主机账户后，运维人员即可使用该账户通过堡垒机登录主机进行运维

CreateHostGroup.description_en: You can create different asset groups based on your business requirements, add assets of the same type to an asset group, and manage assets by category and perform batch operations
CreateHostGroup.description_zh: 您可以按照业务需要创建不同的资产组，然后将同一类型的资产添加到资产组，实现对资产的分类管理和批量操作

CreateHostShareKey.description_en: The shared key feature of Bastionhost allows you to store private keys used for host logon in Bastionhost. After being stored, a private key can be shared across multiple host accounts to improve host account management efficiency
CreateHostShareKey.description_zh: 堡垒机的共享密钥功能可以将用于登录主机的私钥托管在堡垒机中。托管后的私钥可以被共享到多个主机账户中，从而提高主机账户的管理效率

CreateNetworkDomain.description_en: If you want to perform unified O&M on assets that are distributed across different network environments or that are not connected to the virtual private cloud (VPC) where Bastionhost resides, use the network domain feature of Bastionhost. You can configure a proxy server for these assets, create a network domain in Bastionhost and add the proxy server, and then add the assets to the network domain to manage them through Bastionhost
CreateNetworkDomain.description_zh: 如果您想统一运维分布在不同网络环境中或与堡垒机所在专有网络（VPC）网络不互通的资产，推荐使用堡垒机的网络域功能。您可以为这些资产配置一台代理服务器，然后在堡垒机中创建网络域并添加代理服务器，将资产加入该网络域后即可通过堡垒机运维资产

CreateOperationTicket.description_en: Creates an O&M request. When an administrator enables O&M approval in control policies, O&M engineers must create an O&M request and obtain administrator approval before performing O&M operations
CreateOperationTicket.description_zh: 管理员配置控制策略时开启了运维审批时，运维人员需要先创建运维申请且管理员审批通过后才能进行运维

CreatePolicy.description_en: Controls O&M behaviors through Settings for command control, command approval, protocol control, and access control policy to effectively prevent users from executing high-risk commands or performing misoperations, ensuring O&M security
CreatePolicy.description_zh: 通过设置命令控制、命令审批、协议控制、访问控制策略等，对运维行为进行管控，有效防止用户进行高危命令操作或误操作，以保障运维安全

CreateProjectNotifyReceiver.description_en: Creates a notification recipient for a project

CreateRule.description_en: You can create authorization rules to authorize multiple users to manage assets. You can also specify a validity period for an authorization rule. This way, you can manage users and assets in a more efficient manner and limit the time periods during which users can access assets
CreateRule.description_zh: 通过创建授权规则，按需求为多个用户批量授权资产，以及设置这些用户访问资产的有效期。授权规则功能不仅可以提升管理用户和资产的效率，还可以对用户访问资产的时间加以控制

CreateUser.description_en: Adds a user to a bastion host

CreateUserGroup.description_en: Creates a user group for a bastion host

CreateUserPublicKey.description_en: Creates a public key for a bastion host user and hosts the public key in the bastion host. This way, O\\\\\\\\\\\\&M engineers can use the private key that corresponds to the public key to log on to the bastion host from an O\\\\\\\\\\\\&M client
CreateUserPublicKey.description_zh: 您可以创建用户公钥后将公钥托管至堡垒机，运维员即可使用私钥通过运维客户端登录堡垒机

DeleteProjectNotifyReceivers.description_en: Deletes notification recipients from a project

DeleteUserGroup.description_en: Deletes a single user group from a bastion host
DeleteUserGroup.description_zh: 删除单个堡垒机用户组

DeleteUserPublicKey.description_en: Deletes a public key from the specified user

DescribeInstanceAttribute.description_en: Queries all attribute information of an instance, such as the instance ID and instance description
DescribeInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 查询实例所有的属性信息，例如：实例ID、实例的备注信息

DescribeInstances.description_en: Retrieves a list of Bastionhost instances

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the Alibaba Cloud regions that support Bastionhost instances
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例支持的阿里云地域

DetachDatabaseAccountsFromUser.description_en: Revokes permissions on databases and database accounts from a user

DetachDatabaseAccountsFromUserGroup.description_en: Revokes permissions on databases and database accounts from a user group
DetachDatabaseAccountsFromUserGroup.description_zh: 移除给用户组授权的数据库及数据库账户

DetachHostAccountsFromHostShareKey.description_en: Disassociate host accounts from a shared key
DetachHostAccountsFromHostShareKey.description_zh: 移除主机账号和主机共享密钥的关联

DetachHostAccountsFromUser.description_en: Revokes permissions on hosts and host accounts from a user
DetachHostAccountsFromUser.description_zh: 移除给用户授权的主机及主机账户

DetachHostAccountsFromUserGroup.description_en: Revokes the permissions on one or more hosts and host accounts from a user group
DetachHostAccountsFromUserGroup.description_zh: 移除给用户组授权的主机及主机账户

DetachHostGroupAccountsFromUser.description_en: Removes host groups and host accounts from the list of host groups and host accounts that a user is authorized to manage
DetachHostGroupAccountsFromUser.description_zh: 移除用户已授权的主机组及主机账户

DetachHostGroupAccountsFromUserGroup.description_en: Revokes permissions on one or more host groups and host accounts from a user group
DetachHostGroupAccountsFromUserGroup.description_zh: 移除用户组已授权的主机组及主机账户

DetachProjectManagersFromProjectAuthoriz.description_en: Removes a project administrator from project authorization management

DetachProjectsFromProjectAuthorization.description_en: Removes projects from the scope of a project authorization. This operation can be called only when the ScopeType parameter returned by the GetProjectAuthorization operation is 2
DetachProjectsFromProjectAuthorization.description_zh: 移除项目授权范围项目。仅当通过GetProjectAuthorization接口获取到的对应项目授权中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口

DetachProjectsFromReviewRule.description_en: Removes projects from the scope of an audit policy. This operation can be called only when the ScopeType parameter in the corresponding audit policy returned by the GetReviewRule operation has a value of 2
DetachProjectsFromReviewRule.description_zh: 移除审计规则范围项目。仅当通过GetReviewRule接口获取到的对应审计规则中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口

DetachReviewersFromReviewRule.description_en: Unbinds an auditor from an audit rule

DisableInstancePublicAccess.description_en: Disables public network access for a Bastionhost instance
DisableInstancePublicAccess.description_zh: 关闭实例的公网访问开关

EnableInstancePublicAccess.description_en: Enables public network access for a specified Bastionhost instance
EnableInstancePublicAccess.description_zh: 打开指定堡垒机实例公网访问开关

GenerateAssetOperationToken.description_en: Call this operation to request O&M tokens for bastions or databases, which allows you to manage assets
GenerateAssetOperationToken.description_zh: 您可以通过该接口申请主机或数据库运维令牌，并通过运维令牌运维资产

GetDatabase.description_zh: 获取指定数据库的详细信息

GetHostAccount.description_zh: 获取指定主机账户详情

GetInstanceADAuthServer.description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例上AD认证的配置信息

GetInstanceLDAPAuthServer.description_zh: 获取堡垒机实例LDAP认证的配置

GetInstanceStoreInfo.description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例存储空间的使用情况

GetInstanceTwoFactor.description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例的双因子认证的配置信息

GetPolicy.description_zh: 获取指定控制策略详情

ListDatabaseAccountsForUser.description_zh: 查询用户已授权和未授权的数据库账户列表

ListDatabaseAccountsForUserGroup.description_zh: 查询用户组已授权和未授权的数据库账户列表

ListDatabases.description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机实例下的数据库列表

ListDatabasesForUser.description_en: Queries the databases that a user is authorized to manage
ListDatabasesForUser.description_zh: 查询用户已授权的数据库列表

ListDatabasesForUserGroup.description_zh: 查询用户组已授权的数据库列表

ListHostAccountsForHostShareKey.description_en: Queries the host accounts that are associated with a shared key
ListHostAccountsForHostShareKey.description_zh: 获取主机共享密钥关联的主机账号

ListHostAccountsForUser.description_en: Queries the host accounts of a host and whether a user is authorized to manage each host account
ListHostAccountsForUser.description_zh: 查询指定用户在指定主机下已授权和未授权的主机账户列表

ListHostAccountsForUserGroup.description_en: Queries the host accounts of a host and whether a user group is authorized to manage each host account
ListHostAccountsForUserGroup.description_zh: 查询指定用户组在指定主机下已授权和未授权的主机账户列表

ListHostGroupAccountNamesForUser.description_zh: 查询指定用户在指定主机组中已授权的主机账户名称

ListHostGroupAccountNamesForUserGroup.description_zh: 查询指定用户组在指定主机组中已授权的主机账户名称

ListHostGroupsForUserGroup.description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机用户组已授权或未授权的主机组列表

ListHostShareKeys.description_zh: 查询主机共享密钥的列表

ListHostsForUser.description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机用户已授权或未授权的主机列表

ListHostsForUserGroup.description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机用户组已授权或未授权的主机列表

ListImportableKMSSecretsForHost.description_zh: 列出指定主机所有可导入的 KMS 凭据

ListInstanceRdMembers.description_en: Lists the member accounts in a Resource Directory (RD)

ListMembersNotForProject.description_en: Queries the list of members that are not occupied by other projects
ListMembersNotForProject.description_zh: 查询未被其他项目占用的成员列表

ListNetworkDomains.description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的网络域列表

ListOperationDatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的数据库账户列表

ListOperationHosts.description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的主机列表

ListTodoOpsTaskApprovals.description_zh: 获取待处理的自动运维审批列表

ListUserGroups.description_en: Queries a list of user groups on a bastion host
ListUserGroups.description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的用户组列表

ListUserGroupsForUser.description_en: Queries the list of user groups that a user has joined
ListUserGroupsForUser.description_zh: 获取用户加入的用户组列表

ListUserPublicKeys.description_en: Lists the SSH public keys that are configured for a Bastionhost user. Users can use these public keys for key-based authentication when logging on to hosts through Bastionhost
ListUserPublicKeys.description_zh: 查询用户名下所有的公钥列表

ListUsers.description_en: Retrieves the list of users for a specified bastion host
ListUsers.description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机的用户列表

LockUsers.description_en: Locks one or more users of a bastion host

ModifyDatabase.description_en: Modifies the basic information about a database

ModifyDatabaseAccount.description_en: Modifies the basic information about a database account
ModifyDatabaseAccount.description_zh: 修改数据库账户基本信息

ModifyDatabasesProject.description_en: Moves database instances to a different project in batches
ModifyDatabasesProject.description_zh: 批量修改数据库实例所属项目

ModifyHost.description_en: Modifies information about a host. The information includes the address, name, and description of the host and the operating system that the host runs
ModifyHost.description_zh: 支持修改主机的地址、名称、操作系统类型和备注信息

ModifyHostAccount.description_en: Modifies host account information, including the name, password, and private key of a host account
ModifyHostAccount.description_zh: 修改主机账户信息，支持修改主机账户的名称、密码和私钥信息

ModifyHostGroup.description_en: Modifies the name or description of the specified host group
ModifyHostGroup.description_zh: 修改资产组名称或备注信息

ModifyHostsActiveAddressType.description_en: Changes the endpoint type of one or more hosts for O\\\\\\&M. Public and private IP addresses are supported
ModifyHostsActiveAddressType.description_zh: 堡垒机支持公网运维和私网运维，您可以通过本接口修改运维主机时使用的连接地址类型

ModifyHostsPort.description_en: Changes the port for the O\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\&M protocol on one or more hosts
ModifyHostsPort.description_zh: 堡垒机对于服务器的RDP和SSH协议使用的是默认端口（RDP协议默认使用3389端口，SSH协议默认使用22端口），如果您在主机中自定义了端口，可通过本接口进行修改

ModifyHostsProject.description_en: Moves hosts to a different project in a batch
ModifyHostsProject.description_zh: 批量修改主机所属项目

ModifyInstanceADAuthServer.description_en: Updates the settings of the Active Directory (AD) authentication server of a bastion host
ModifyInstanceADAuthServer.description_zh: 修改堡垒机实例的AD认证服务器的配置

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the information of a specified bastion host instance
ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 修改指定堡垒机实例的信息

ModifyInstanceLDAPAuthServer.description_en: Updates the settings of the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) authentication server of a bastion host
ModifyInstanceLDAPAuthServer.description_zh: 修改堡垒机实例LDAP认证服务器的配置

ModifyInstanceTwoFactor.description_en: Modifies the two-factor authentication settings of a bastion host
ModifyInstanceTwoFactor.description_zh: 修改堡垒机实例的双因子配置

ModifyNetworkDomain.description_en: Modifies the basic information about a network domain

ModifyPolicy.description_en: Modifies the basic information about a control policy
ModifyPolicy.description_zh: 修改控制策略基本信息

ModifyProjectNotifyReceiver.description_en: Modifies the notification recipient of a project

ModifyRule.description_en: Modifies the basic information of an authorization rule
ModifyRule.description_zh: 修改授权规则基本信息

ModifyUser.description_en: Modifies the information about a user of a bastion host

ModifyUserGroup.description_en: Modifies the information about a user group

ModifyUserPublicKey.description_en: Modifies the public key of the user

MoveDatabasesToNetworkDomain.description_en: Adds multiple databases to a network domain at a time
MoveDatabasesToNetworkDomain.description_zh: 批量将数据库移入指定网络域

MoveHostsToNetworkDomain.description_en: Adds multiple hosts to a network domain at a time
MoveHostsToNetworkDomain.description_zh: 批量将主机移入指定网络域

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Moves a Bastionhost instance to a specified resource group
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 移动堡垒机实例至指定资源组

RejectApproveCommand.description_en: If an O\\\&M engineer attempts to run a command specified in the Command Approval section of the Create Control Policy page, the administrator is notified to review the command in the Bastionhost console. The command can be run only after it is approved by the administrator
RejectApproveCommand.description_zh: 如果运维员执行了配置在命令审批控制策略中的命令，管理员会在堡垒机控制台收到该命令的审批，只有管理员审批允许后该命令才能正常执行，审批拒绝后该命令不可执行

RejectOperationTaskApproval.description_en: Rejects an O&M task execution request
RejectOperationTaskApproval.description_zh: 拒绝运维任务执行申请

RejectOperationTicket.description_en: If a Bastionhost administrator enables O\\\\\\&M Approval on the Create Control Policy page, O\\\\\\&M engineers can log on to assets to perform O\\\\\\&M operations only after the administrator approves their O\\\\\\&M applications
RejectOperationTicket.description_zh: 如果管理员配置控制策略时开启了运维审批，则运维员登录资产时，需要申请运维且管理员审批通过后才能进行运维

RemoveDatabasesFromGroup.description_en: Removes multiple databases from an asset group at a time
RemoveDatabasesFromGroup.description_zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除数据库

RemoveHostsFromGroup.description_en: Removes multiple hosts from an asset group at a time
RemoveHostsFromGroup.description_zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除主机

RemoveInstanceRdMember.description_en: Removes a Resource Directory (RD) member account from a Bastionhost instance. You must remove all assets of the member account from Bastionhost before you call this operation

RemoveUsersFromGroup.description_en: Removes one or more users from a user group
RemoveUsersFromGroup.description_zh: 批量移除用户组内用户

RenewAssetOperationToken.description_en: Renews an O\\\&M token for one hour
RenewAssetOperationToken.description_zh: 您可以通过该接口续期运维令牌，单次可将运维令牌续期1小时

ResetHostAccountCredential.description_en: Clears the credential (password or SSH private key) for a specified host account
ResetHostAccountCredential.description_zh: 清除指定主机账户登录凭据（密码或SSH私钥）

SetPolicyAccessTimeRangeConfig.description_en: Configures the logon period limits in a control policy
SetPolicyAccessTimeRangeConfig.description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的登录时段限制配置

SetPolicyApprovalConfig.description_en: Configures the O\&M approval setting in a control policy
SetPolicyApprovalConfig.description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的运维审批配置

SetPolicyAssetScope.description_en: Sets the asset scope for a specified control policy
SetPolicyAssetScope.description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的资产生效范围

SetPolicyCommandConfig.description_en: Specifies the commands that can or cannot be run by the users or on the assets associated with the policy and the commands that must be reviewed
SetPolicyCommandConfig.description_zh: 配置在指定策略生效用户和主机中，允许或禁止执行的命令，以及需要审批的命令

SetPolicyIPAclConfig.description_en: Specifies whether a source IP address can access the assets to which a control policy applies
SetPolicyIPAclConfig.description_zh: 配置来源IP是否可以访问当前策略生效的主机

SetPolicyProtocolConfig.description_en: Sets the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), Secure Shell (SSH), and SSH File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) options for a control policy
SetPolicyProtocolConfig.description_zh: 配置控制策略的RDP选项、SSH选项以及SFTP选项

SetPolicyUserScope.description_en: Specifies the users to whom a control policy applies
SetPolicyUserScope.description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的用户生效范围

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to one or more Bastionhost instances
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的堡垒机实例统一创建并绑定标签

UnlockUsers.description_en: Unlocks one or more users of a bastion host

UntagResources.description_en: Unbinds and deletes tags from a specified Bastionhost instance in batches
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定堡垒机实例批量解绑并删除标签

VerifyInstanceADAuthServer.description_en: Tests the connectivity to the Active Directory (AD) authentication server configured for a Bastionhost instance. Use this operation to validate your AD settings before you save them

VerifyInstanceLDAPAuthServer.description_en: Tests the connectivity to the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) authentication server configured for a Bastionhost instance. Use this operation to validate your LDAP settings before you save them
